In development · Private test version

Meet Arc by Nortivo.

One place to follow your spending, your food and your days.

Explore the features

Arc is being tested privately. There is no public download here yet.

Money and budgets Food and calories Steps and progress

A clearer view of your own money.

Record income, expenses and refunds. Set a monthly budget, choose category limits and see what remains. These figures come from your entries, not a bank connection.

Budgets help you keep track. They do not block purchases.

From food to meal.

Search Matvaretabellen and Open Food Facts, choose an amount and log the food. Save favourites, your own products and meals you use again.

Food data may be incomplete. Check amounts and nutrition against the label.

See how your days connect.

Enter steps manually, set your own goals and open previous days. A recorded zero is different from a day without an entry.

Arc does not automatically read steps from your watch or phone.

Your entries. On your device.

Entries are stored locally. You can make JSON backups and export financial records as CSV. Your phone and PC do not sync automatically.

Back up regularly. Clearing browser or app data can remove your records.

Good to know

Can I download Arc now?

Arc is a private test version in development. We will add a real download when a public release is ready.

Is Arc available in Norwegian and English?

Yes, the app has Norwegian Bokmål and English. Changing the language on this website does not change the app’s language, data, currency or food market.

Does Arc work offline?

Local entries and saved foods can be used offline. New external food searches and some resources need a connection.

How do I get help?

Use the support page. You receive a ticket number and replies by email. Verify your email before opening a private conversation.

Need help with a product?

Already have a ticket? Open support to read your reply or ask for help.
